identity.description: Reasons directly over the citation star-map graph (215 papers, 700 keyword-co-occurrence edges): most central papers per topic, 1-hop subgraphs around a paper, community overview, bridge papers (betweenness), and shortest paths between papers. LLM-free — pure graph computation, instant and near-free. Returns a subgraph.json artifact when a subgraph or path is requested.

inputs.description: A graph question: "most central papers in Connectomics", "subgraph around <paper>", "shortest path between <A> and <B>", "bridge papers", "communities"

outputs.description: Graph answer (rankings, subgraphs, paths) computed from the star-map
Requested subgraph / path as graph_data.json-shaped JSON (nodes + links), ready to visualize
Papers involved in the answer as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)
